item.title: Jay-Z’s Yankee Stadium Night One Setlist: Every Song Played at the First Show
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the show! We've got some exciting news for all you Jay-Z fans out there. Last Friday, the legendary rapper kicked off his highly anticipated three-night run at Yankee Stadium, and it was an unforgettable night.
[Short music transition]
Host: Jay-Z delivered a thrilling performance, reimagining his classic 1996 debut album "Reasonable Doubt" with a live band. The crowd was wowed by his seamless transitions between hits like "Ain't No N—a" and "Excuse Me Miss". But what really made the night special was the family affair – Beyoncé joined him on stage for "Can't Knock the Hustle", and their daughter Blue Ivy Carter even showed off her piano skills on "Feelin' It".
[Short music transition]
Host: But Jay-Z didn't just stick to the oldies. He also debuted a sharp new freestyle, addressing critics of his recent Target deal. And, in a night full of surprises, he reunited with old friends Memphis Bleek and Jaz-O, and even brought out former rival Nas for a epic mash-up of "Dead Presidents" and "New York State of Mind". The crowd went wild when Alicia Keys joined him for their hit single "Empire State of Mind".
[Short music transition]
Host: The star-studded audience included the likes of LeBron James, Megan Thee Stallion, and Leonardo DiCaprio, just to name a few. With two more nights to go, we can't wait to see what Jay-Z has in store for us. Stay tuned for more updates, and check out the full setlist from Night One of his Yankee Stadium run.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!
